content.content:
Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier assigned to owners that deliberately share a
                household (same lastName and address, created with sharesHousehold true). Owners in
                the same household carry the same value; owners with a unique household have none.
              type: string
              example: 3f2504e0-4f89-31e3-9d64-fb1a2f9c1e11
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and
                lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007-M26
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 derived at read time.
                Starts at 1; add 1 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; capped
                at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's region, derived at read time. The postcode is preferred - a
                4-digit postcode in a known region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
                QLD 4000-4099) yields that region, disambiguating cities that share a name. When the
                postcode is absent or in no known range it falls back to the pinned city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' otherwise.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time. 'EMAIL' when
                an email is present; otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived at read time from birthDate against the
                registrationDate. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or
                over. Absent when the owner has no birthDate.
              type: string
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived duplicate-detection key,
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and householdId empty when absent).
                All duplicate detection is expressed through this one key; a create whose whole
                identityKey equals an existing owner's is rejected with 409. Two members of the same
                household with different telephones have different identityKeys and are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3f2504e0-4f89-31e3-9d64-fb1a2f9c1e11'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration business day at the moment it was created; otherwise false. Evaluated
                and fixed at creation.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'

        - type

## Summary

I implemented the soft-match "possible duplicate" rule for `POST /api/owners`. A new owner that isn't a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's `lastName` and `postcode` with a *different* telephone is still created, and flagged so `GET /api/owners/{id}` returns `possibleDuplicate: true` with `possibleDuplicateOf` set to the matching owner's id; otherwise `possibleDuplicate: false`.

Changes:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added `possibleDuplicate` (boolean) and `possibleDuplicateOf` (int32) as read-only properties on the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries them and the mapper exposes them on GET.

2. **`Owner` entity** — added persisted `possible_duplicate` / `possible_duplicate_of` columns with getters/setters.

3. **`schema.sql`** (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres) — added the two columns to the `owners` table.

4. **`DetectPossibleDuplicate`** (new OfficeFloor function) — runs after `BuildOwner` (owner has normalized telephone, lastName, postcode) and only for owners that already passed the hard-duplicate `EnsureUniqueIdentity` check. It scans existing owners for one sharing `lastName` + `postcode` with a different telephone (lowest id when several match), setting the flag and match id, else `false`.

5. **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired the new `possibleDuplicate` step into the pipeline before `save` (under the same `transaction` governance).

6. **`OwnerMapper`** — added `ignore = true` mappings for the two new read-only fields on the `OwnerFieldsDto → Owner` mapping, consistent with the other derived fields.

The rule keys off the normalized/stored telephone and postcode, so it composes correctly with the existing telephone-normalization and postcode-validation steps that run earlier in the pipeline.
